name: cool-cam
description: MCP-enabled open-source CAM for the Shapeoko HDM: 2.5D toolpaths, stock simulation, 3D web viewer.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/post packages/sim packages/server packages/mcp && tsc -p packages/viewer --noEmit && tsc -p packages/desktop --noEmit
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @cool-cam/mcp && npm run dev -w @cool-cam/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist -w @cool-cam/desktop
scripts.install:desktop: if pgrep -f "Applications/Cool CAM.app/Contents/MacOS/Cool CAM$" >/dev/null; then echo "Cool CAM is running from ~/Applications: quit it first (replacing a running app crashes it)"; exit 1; fi; rsync -a --delete "packages/desktop/dist/mac-universal/Cool CAM.app/" "$HOME/Applications/Cool CAM.app/" && echo "installed to ~/Applications/Cool CAM.app"
